statements.statement: The patient has exertional dyspnea and palpitations
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
The claim was denied for missing required prior authorization
